full_text:
Article 1 (Purpose)
The purpose of these Rules is to prescribe the standards for expenses payable to persons who participate in proceedings before the Constitutional Court and make statements, etc., pursuant to Article 30 (2) of the Constitutional Court Act and other relevant provisions. <Amended on April 30, 2026.>
